value.rationale: The 2023 primary work explicitly treats the late-time decay scale as a separate operational detection criterion and notes an optimal rate without an exact formula. This theorem provides the unique exact global control rate for all coupled two-level Hamiltonians, shows that the same choice controls return and transition tails, and quantifies the sharp divergence from optimal mean-transition and monotone mean-return regimes. This is a natural complete parameter classification, not merely a parameter substitution or numerical fit; the rate change is modest and no large empirical benefit is claimed.
